content:
Sofia: Proposal — add a lightweight 'x-rw-degrade' header from gateway to edge proxies to signal degraded-mode routing when capacity is constrained. Intended to be advisory and low-overhead.
Anya: quick q — is this per-request or per-connection?
Sofia: per-request (stateless) header emitted by gateway routing layer. Value set to one of:
  - "none"
  - "soft" (prefer lower-cost model / cache / 304)
  - "hard" (drop non-essential streaming, return minimal payload)
Mike: so basically the gateway decides the degradation tier and downstream proxies can opt into cheaper handling. ok. How do we ensure no infinite retry loops?
Raj: we should attach the original route id and a degrade-version token so retries/hedges know if they've seen a degrade decision. maybe "x-rw-degrade:v2;route=abc123"
Keiko: +1 on token. Also need to define semantics for streaming responses: if a proxy returns truncated stream because of hard degrade, how does client know to re-request full?
Sofia: idea: embed a small postamble metadata trailer when we half-close the stream: `degrade:hard;partial:true;reason=capacity` — client SDKs can detect and surface a soft error code (RW_DEGRADED_PARTIAL).
Anya: trailers are spotty across HTTP/1.1 clients. We should prefer an inline JSON preface when streaming start indicates degraded mode. e.g., first chunk `{"__meta":{"degrade":"soft"}}`
Mike: hmm agreed on compatibility. But adding first-chunk meta changes token accounting and parsing for streaming consumers (esp. tokenizers). We need SDK guidance.
Sofia: SDK guidance will be separate. For architecture: we need routing rules. My thought: gateway sets degrade header when node-level states show sustained queue depth > threshold OR global capacity-preserving signal. Edge proxies honor degrade header to pick: model-variant, caching, or early-truncate.
Raj: tradeoff: honoring degrade at proxy means proxies must be able to select model variants locally. That increases model-config surface on edge nodes. Do we want that?
Keiko: we already push lightweight quantized variants to edge for latency. This just formalizes the selection signal. Implementation: proxy exposes a `variant_map` config (priority list) + degrade policy hooks.
ingress-bot: [alert] node pool gpux-east-2 entered high load at 2025-11-12T09:02:11Z — candidate degrade=soft
Anya: about retries — if a client retries a degraded response, should gateway re-issue degrade or escalate? My worry: naive retry can oscillate degrade/hard-degrade cycles causing flapping.
Sofia: policy: gateway marks degraded decisions with a short TTL (like 30s) keyed by route+customer. Retries within TTL should keep same degrade=... to avoid escalation loops. New attempts after TTL can re-evaluate.
Mike: what about hedging? If we issue a hedge to a non-degraded replica the hedge should include the observed degrade token so replicas know not to ignore the advisory.
Raj: also need monitoring tags: `degrade.tier=soft/hard`, `degrade.origin=gateway|orchestrator`, `degrade.ttl`. Use those for SLO/alerting.
Keiko: fallback content strategies: for soft degrade prefer cache-with-validation (304), model quantized variant, or partial embeddings. For hard degrade prefer synthetic minimal response or 429 with `Retry-After` and `x-rw-degrade:hard`.
Anya: client ergonomics: SDK should expose `response.isDegraded` and `degradeMetadata` so product teams can decide UX (e.g., show spinner vs snackbar).
Sofia: another edge case: streamed tool-calls (e.g., tool outputs emitted progressively) — if we switch to hard degrade mid-stream, we must neutralize side-effectful tool invocations. That means the gateway must prevent proxies from starting side-effecting calls if a degrade is anticipated.
Mike: that's tough. Maybe rule: once a request may trigger side-effects, gateway must lock `degrade=none` or reject with 503 if capacity insufficient. No partial side-effectful execution allowed.
Raj: agree — side effects are non-negotiable. We should document `degrade-immune` flags on routes.
Keiko: ops: rollout plan — start with `soft` advisory only, metrics + SDK flags, 2-week opt-in on a canary subset, then enable automated gateway emission for selected clusters.
Sofia: next steps — I'll draft a short RFC with API surface (header syntax), proxy config knobs, telemetry tags, and a few sample flows (stream truncated, cache 304, hard 429). Comments by EOD?
Anya: will review. A couple nit: make header key `x-rw-degrade` and keep values lowercase.
Mike: LGTM. Also add explicit guidance on retry behavior in SDK (no client-side exponential backoff that ignores `Retry-After`).
Raj: adding a required audit log entry when a proxy honors a `hard` degrade (for compliance).
Keiko: logging + metric. /me +1
Sofia: thanks — will send RFC link here once ready :thumbsup:
ingress-bot: deploy-check: RFC draft added to `docs/architecture/degrade-signal-rfc.md` (PR #4512) — CI passed on canary
Sofia: sweet, will sync with infra tomorrow to start canary config.
